notes.title: Eden Falling Advances: Transitioning to Late Stage Alpha Test
notes.notes:
[b]Pheonix, Arizona (April 26, 2024)[/b] – Razor Edge Games is excited to announce the forthcoming close of our Early Alpha testing after two impactful years. As we prepare to usher in the Late Stage Alpha Test, we extend our deepest gratitude to the more than 21,000 testers whose dedication has been integral to this development phase.

Our community's insights and feedback have been invaluable. Your engagement has led to meaningful bug fixes and enhancements that directly shape the Eden Falling experience. As we conclude the Early Alpha, please note that all Early Alpha keys will be disabled in preparation for the new phase. This measure ensures a fresh and streamlined start for the upcoming Late Stage Alpha Test.

Stay tuned for more details on how to participate in the Late Stage Alpha. We are committed to making this transition as smooth as possible for our testers and will provide continuous updates on how existing testers can re-engage with the game in its next iteration.

Razor Edge Games is proud to be an independent studio driven by a team of passionate gamers. Your ongoing support and feedback are essential to us as we craft games that explore the realms of imagination and innovation.

We invite our dedicated community to join us as we move into this exciting new phase of development. Your involvement is crucial as we continue to refine Eden Falling and push the boundaries of indie gaming.

For more information and updates about the Late Stage Alpha Test, please visit https://razoredgegames.com/.

Thank you to every one of you who has joined us on this journey so far. We are eager to explore new challenges and achieve greater heights together in Eden Falling.

notes.title: Dev Journal: The Level Design Team's Role in the HDRP Conversion
notes.notes:
Hey all, Level Design team checking in with a brief update!


Recently with the changeover to HDRP, a lot of major progress with level work has been halted. As one can probably imagine, updating all the assets to work with the new requirements for HDRP, one might find some issues. Some assets need more full-fledged fixes. It is also a great time to do some spring cleaning. (It’s spring, right? I’m a gamer, so I rarely head outside or see the Sun.) Some of our more artistic team members have volunteered to help out with the Art team getting assets updated and organized.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30827111/6aad161ccb3c34cdcc3e63f68ce73a6f5f0e52b1.png[/img]
[i]Note: the environments seen in this post are pre-HDRP conversion
[/i]


Work on our levels has not halted. We are going back through our completed scenes and making sure everything is updated correctly. Our first target was the roadhouse scenes, including the bar-like amenity and the main menu. We needed our wall kit fixed up.


Right now, our focus is on getting the early roadhouse scenes fixed up, but with only two of them in the current demo, that isn’t much work to spread around the team. While we have gotten most of the stuff needed to fix up the roadhouses, we need to get the rest of our team something to do. With that in mind and the wall kit in hand, we have started to focus on the other demo scenes with the same wall kit pieces, which are about every scene. We’ve now gotten the walls working again, albeit with a new textural bug rearing its head (ah, the joys of game development), so we’ll show off our fixes for that in the next journal.

 
That leaves us with our next big target to tackle: the settlement. The settlement recently got updated right before we swapped over to HDRP; not sure if it made it into the last builds or not, but looking at it now, it will need a lot of work to get back up to where it was before the swap over, but our team members are up for the task.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30827111/e6a5bb44df125d2cc5cf8b881572d3d72b09b43e.png[/img]

notes.notes:
Last Updated: 7/17/2021

Welcome survivors!

Today marks the official start of the Eden Falling Closed Alpha 1 and we are excited to see you tackle the game in various ways and report any bugs that you find!

Before we get into the details of testing, there is a Code of Conduct that must be followed. Any breaches of the Code of Conduct will result in an immediate revocation of your Alpha-1 key and possible further action, so make sure you read over this document thoroughly before you begin testing. A copy of the Code of Conduct will be provided in the email containing your Alpha-1 key. You can also click the link below to view this document. 

[url=https://edenfalling.razoredgegames.com/alpha-terms-of-service/]Click here to view Code of Conduct
[/url]
Use the following link to report any bugs that you find. We encourage you to bookmark this link for the duration of testing for quick and easy access. 

[url=https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLScwZ1YQW4AM4McuQ4GNh07lyEMpB8isqMXvdi_Ca3r913sIVg/viewform]Click here to view Bug Report Form
[/url]
We want to make sure players get the most out of testing. That is why we’ve implemented a reward system for players who are dedicated to testing the game. During testing, you’ll have the chance to earn your “Stripes.” These stripes come in the form of special tags for the player, exclusive in-game rewards that will be available to players at the launch of the full game, invites to our private Discord channel as well as future testing events, and more. 

[url=https://edenfalling.razoredgegames.com/eden-falling-stripes/]Click here to learn more about Stripes and how you can earn them.
[/url]
Rewards will be given based on the amount of hours played and unique bugs reported. Hours may roll over for continued use in future test sessions so that players can continue to play and collect as many rewards as they can (For example: In the event that we have an Alpha-2 test, if you’ve played 15 hours during Alpha-1 testing then you’ll begin Alpha-2 at 15 hours). Hours you play will be catalogued and you will be retroactively compensated when the stripes are implemented upon the release of the game.

Finally, we want to remind everyone that Eden Falling is still in early development, and that this build of the game is not a representation of what the final product will look like. This means that various aspects of the game are subject to change before the actual release of the game. 

We encourage you to Wishlist Eden Falling on Steam and follow us on all social media platforms to keep up with the latest news and updates about the development of Eden Falling.

We want to thank everyone who will be joining us for Alpha-1 testing. Have fun, and remember to check this announcement daily for any updates pertaining to testing.

Please explain what happened and the exact steps you took when the bug occurred. 
Screen shots and detailed descriptions are ideal
Indicate whether you were able to repeat the bug in the game
Or when you log out and try to duplicate it does not happen. 
One-shots are not very useful. Both you and us have to be able to repeat it.
If the game crashes or glitches out, please disable any other programs that you have running on your PC, i.e., close any unnecessary programs.
We have fixed a lot of bugs during the Pre Alpha run and we continue to work hard fixing and adding new content regularly.

notes.title: EDEN FALLING - 2020 Updates
notes.notes:
Fellow Survivors!  We are alive and well, despite all that the Afterfall has thrown at us.
The road has been long and the challenges vast, but we at Razor Edge Games are committed to bringing you a game that fulfills the promises that have made to our fans. We are uncompromising in achieving our vision, and unlike certain AAA studios which shall remain nameless, we are not interested in delivering an inferior product just to capitalize on hype.
We appreciate your patience, and we promise that it is not in vain.
 
Since our last update we have made numerous revisions and updates to ensure our game is as engaging and immersive as possible. These improvements encompass every department of our production, and including but not limited to the following:

[list]
[*] Improved environments and level design. Coding enhancements have enabled us to create interactive scenes, and properly implement cover and other combat elements. Environments are modularly generated, allowing for endless exploration and unique play-through experiences, but also regionally aligned, meaning that every area has its own dangers and strategic approach.
[*]Fully integrated weather effects which not only provide their own challenges and dangers, but which also affect the world at large. Did a meteor shower or spore storm pass over your favorite settlement? You’d best pray they survived the experience!
[*]Settlements, the precious pockets of relative safety for survivors of the Fall, have been modulated to allow ~100k possible unique locations. Every friendly location you explore will have its own technological level, unique NPCs, available quests, amenities, and more.
[*]Coding for the complex quest system has been completed, allowing for 10s of thousands of possible quests and contracts. An adaptive quest delivery and reward system means that no playthrough experience will be the same; quests have triggers and story branches which can depend on world state, season, faction alignment, and other player-based and environmental factors.
[*]Completely revamped User Interface to improve player experience. All map and navigation elements are in place, as well as place of interest and settlement amenities. Our world is primed to explore using an intuitive and engaging menu of choices and control.
[*]The combat module is complete. Enemy and friendly NPC AI now accounts for available cover, concealment, wound level, morale, and relative intelligence. Expect your opponents to respond to environmental cues and exploit the same advantages or disadvantages you would!
[*]The combat camera has been fully implemented, allowing players to witness their success or failure through an exciting, cinematic lens. Issue commands to your character and followers using a turn-based (but time-sensitive!) system and watch the action unfold.
[*]Working VFX now include plasma and laser weapon graphics, dynamic environmental lighting, realistic water effects, holograms, and holographic displays. We’ve overhauled all textures and shaders to increase immersion; characters, objects, and the environment reflect wear, accumulation of dirt, and damage.
[*]Character animation has been improved to a level of detail that includes lip-synced speech, hair, and clothing. Character and NPC models also adjust to reflect their attributes and stats.
[*]Cleaned up and streamlined a TON of code, reducing overall system requirements without sacrificing quality. Scene loading times have been cut nearly 80% to minimize the time players spend waiting to explore new regions or places of interest.
[*]Video recording and playback system is in place, allowing for players to record their most epic moments and visceral combat encounters. Post your stories and videos to the community forum to share your experiences with other survivors.
[*]We’ve expanded the marketing department to maintain a more active presence on social media and keep our growing fanbase better informed. Follow us on Facebook, Twitter, and Instagram to stay abreast of changes, and watch for the emergence of our playable demo!
[/list]
  
Last but not least, we’ve revamped our website. [b]Check it out here![/b]
